clips.title: The story
paras: In Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor, Nogg puts his craft to work for the Horde. The goblin engineer studies strange mechanical salvage from deep within Gnomeregan.

Nogg runs an independent engineering workshop in Orgrimmar's Valley of Honor. Adventurers and craftsmen come to him for the mechanical skill only a goblin can offer in a city known for orcish steel and strength. He is eager to examine unusual devices and trinkets brought back from Alliance lands or underground ruins.

Salvage from Gnomeregan draws Nogg's special attention. When Horde operatives recover intricate rings and other remnants from the fallen gnomish capital, few minds in Durotar can take apart, decipher, and adapt those strange clockwork devices for Horde use.
